sources.title: flan-t5-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview FLAN-T5 base is a text-to-text transformer model by google that improves upon the base T5 architecture through instruction fine-tuning on over 1000 additional tasks across 55+ languages. The model uses the standard T5 encoder-decoder architecture and has been fine-tuned on a diverse mixture of NLP tasks to achieve strong zero-shot and few-shot performance.
